title: Embrace – Embrace health care
text: Scroll to top How can we help? Ask me anything about our services… Psychosocial Recovery Coaches Psychosocial Recovery Coaches guide individuals with psychosocial disabilities towards leading fuller lives by helping them access specific supports. They coach on recovery and decision-making, aiming for greater independence and crafting tailored Recovery and Crisis Management Plans. Leveraging their mental health expertise, our team ensures you receive top-notch support to achieve your goals. This plan includes Empowering Recovery and Building Resilience Our support focuses on nurturing strong, respectful relationships to empower individuals with psychosocial disabilities to lead fulfilling and contributory lives. Through the episodic journey of mental health, our Recovery Coaches maintain engagement, adapting to changing support needs. Working in harmony with participants, families, and carers, they craft and coordinate tailored NDIS supports. With both lived experience and professional qualifications, our coaches bring understanding and expertise to guide you towards resilience and independence.
